description: Send one of the member's own DRAFT settle-privately invoices to its GigXchange recipient (notifies them + posts the invoice card in chat). Platform-generated booking invoices are refused — GigXchange sends those automatically. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

invoice_id.description: The invoice id (drafts appear in my_invoices with status draft).

name: submit_my_invoice
title: Send a drafted invoice
